notes.title: 0.5 version update instructions
notes.content:
0.5 version update instructions
New system features:
1. Add a Boss Challenge mode (BossRush) to enable interoperability between growth data and regional modes.
This mode allows you to choose between simple and difficult challenges, and enjoy the ultimate boss strategy battles.
2. Add a new card mode (DBG Meat Pigeon Card), which combines the shield breaking mechanism with card games.
The current value of this mode is unbalanced, the system is missing, and there are many bugs.
3. Add a Boss guide, which allows you to view the original boss paintings and introductions that appear in the game.
4. Regional mode allows you to obtain the key to open the cabin.
Function optimization:
1. Optimize the performance of the archive interface.
2. Optimize the performance of the announcement interface.
3. Optimize the combat entry experience.
4. Optimize the operation buttons of the regional mode combat interface.
5. Optimize regional mode and explore map display.
Archive:
The old save may not be usable. It is recommended to delete the old save before playing the game.
Archive path: C:  Users  Administrator  AppData  LocalLow  Guqingquan  BlackFighter  mdb
The administrator may be the computer user name.
